use_case_summary: Primary goal: replace slow keyword search with vector-powered semantic search for help center + product docs and power recommendations. Secondary: nightly bulk re-embedding pipeline for freshness and monthly analytics. Requirements: high embed throughput for nightly jobs, predictable unit economics, low single-query latency, easy integration with existing vector DB (prefer client-managed Pinecone but open to alternative patterns). Wants evaluation of caching, batching, and fallback routing to cheaper models for cost control.
